description: Keep the index fresh: a full incremental re-index at session start, plus a lightweight hub push after every turn so teammates see the session as it happens.

hooks.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/bin:$PATH"; sr=session-recall; pgrep -f "$sr sync" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { command -v "$sr" >/dev/null 2>&1 && ("$sr" sync >/tmp/session-recall-index.log 2>&1 &) || echo 'session-recall: CLI not on PATH - history not synced (see README: Keeping the index fresh)' >>/tmp/session-recall-index.log; }

[ -f "$HOME/.local/share/session-recall/hub.json" ] || exit 0; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/bin:$PATH"; sr=session-recall; command -v "$sr" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; pgrep -f "$sr hub push" >/dev/null 2>&1 || ("$sr" hub push >>/tmp/session-recall-push.log 2>&1 &)

[ -f "$HOME/.local/share/session-recall/hub.json" ] || exit 0; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/bin:$PATH"; sr=session-recall; command -v "$sr" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; pgrep -f "$sr hub push" >/dev/null 2>&1 || ("$sr" hub push >>/tmp/session-recall-push.log 2>&1 &)
